name: Belg rainfall areas (EMI definition: FMAM >=20% of annual and >=100 mm)
definition: Fixed 1993-2025 descriptive domain (Belg / Gu / Ganna): cells where FMAM brings at least 20% of the mean annual CHIRPS rainfall, with FMAM climatological rainfall >=100 mm; patches smaller than 3 cells removed. The same domain is used for the season and each of its months.
note: Smooth outline: Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 0.6 cells) 0/1 mask contoured at 0.5, clipped to the national boundary, pieces < 500 km2 dropped. The forecast statistics use the 0.25-degree cell mask.
